title: Q9
description:
Read: Exo 29:4, Exo 29:21, Eze 36:25-27

Priests are washed with water and sprinkled with blood before they minister. A people is promised clean water, a new heart, and the Spirit, so that they walk in the statutes.

a) Hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and bodies washed with pure water. What is the sprinkling, and what is the washing, if they are not two names for one inner change?
